_how_to_edit: repo is optional (owner/name on GitHub). When given, the page shows the repository's stars, language and last update automatically. site is optional: the tool's own website, linked alongside GitHub. beta: true shows a Beta tag.

lab.name: Gamma Line Explorer
lab.text: Identify gamma lines in low-background spectra: natural radioactivity, cosmogenics, neutron capture (n,γ) and inelastic lines, with the correlations that test each hypothesis.

lab.name: NeuCBOT
lab.text: A neutron calculator based on TALYS that estimates (α,n) yields from known radioactive contamination.

lab.name: G4RiversideCASCADE
lab.text: A Geant4 module that uses ENSDF data to simulate de-excitation cascades in (n,γ) reactions.

lab.name: NEST
lab.text: The Noble Element Simulation Technique: simulates scintillation and ionization signals in liquid argon and liquid xenon.
